messages:
Alex Chen: Quick QBR run-through for Acme — need slide owners, demo cue cards, and exec 3-min readout. Can people reply with owner + availability for a dry run this week?

Maria Gomez: I can own the onboarding health slide. Will add latest usage/DAU and migration blockers.

Samir Patel: I'll take the renewal risks slide. Quick note: legal is still finalizing contract terms — flagging as medium risk.

Jordan Lee: Demo scripts: I can draft the happy-path and one failover scenario. Need a short script for the new KPI panel.

Casey (CSM): I'll collect customer feedback bullets and put together two customer quotes to use on slide 4. Also coordinating enablement video snippet.

Alex Chen: Perf: can someone make 'talk tracks' with timestamps? Exec wants a 3-min readout + 10-min deep dive.

Samir Patel: timeline suggestion:
- by EOD Wed: rough slides
- Thu AM: dry run 30min
- Thu PM: slide polish
- Fri: final exec rehearsal

Maria Gomez: EOD Wed works for me. I'll post the onboarding metrics table into the slide deck (link: https://drive.redwood/acme/qbr)

Jordan Lee: Dry run Thu 10:30 PT works. @Casey can you prep the enablement clip by then?

Casey (CSM): Yep, putting the clip together — ~90s. Will post draft by Wed afternoon.

ops-bot: Reminder: presentation recording + upload enabled for Thu dry run :bell:

Alex Chen: Demo cue cards (very short):
```
1) Login + data flow (30s)
2) Dashboard KPIs (60s)
3) Latency & cost improvements (45s)
4) Failover scenario (30s)
5) Ask: expansion & pilot approval (15s)
```

Samir Patel: Action items:
- Samir: finalize renewal risk wording + mitigations (due Wed)
- Maria: onboarding metrics & blockers table (due Wed)
- Jordan: demo scripts + runbook (due Wed)
- Casey: enablement clip + customer quotes (due Wed)
- Alex: assemble exec readout + slide order (due Thu morning)

Maria Gomez: Noted. I'll also flag the two customers who saw >30% usage uplift for the case study slide.

Casey (CSM): Quick ask — can sales provide one L2 contact for follow-up? Need for enablement handoff.

Samir Patel: I'll ping Sales: @marco-sales to confirm.

Alex Chen: Thanks all. If anyone cannot hit Wed, call it out now so we can reprioritize. :thumbsup:

Jordan Lee: All good from my side.

Casey (CSM): On track.

Maria Gomez: On track but might need a 1-hr slot Thu morning for polish.

ops-bot: Thread archived automatically in 7 days unless pinned.
